title: DropAHead
description: What's that fallen? It's someone's head....
body:
# Drop A Head!

A simple plugin that adds a player's head drop when killed with an axe!

![Head](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d1b31d5e9650a17200eaf28007988f19f2595a2.gif)

# Bug report and sources
You can find the open source code, or report the issue on the official [github repository](https://github.com/lr1ne/DropAHead).
